items.title: Fred Minor Interview, 1961-11-01
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...You talking about St. Joseph? St. Joseph. [INTERVIEWEE] St. Joseph at Tulane and Roman. Yeah.

ctx.x: Yeah, I didn't know that place. It's on Roman between... Between Perdida and Gravia. And where's the big church, the big cathedral or whatever it is in there? You talking about St. Joseph? St. Joseph.
St. Joseph at Tulane and Roman. Yeah. And the Tulane Club is on Gravia in there, Roman. And this is on Roman between Gravia and Perdida. Oh, yes.
And around the corner of the town. That's right. Which side of the street, the river? On the river side.
